title: Design System: The More Things Change

station.purpose: Wordmark, years, dates, and reading-order numerals.

motion.name: level-draw
motion.purpose: Masthead double rule draws in from the left once.

components.name: Theme toggle
components.description: Switches the field book between the desk and the lamp.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.0625rem; color: #14241c; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #b7c9be; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.35rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: #9d1c1c; color: #9d1c1c; } .ds-theme-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9d1c1c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary nav
components.description: About, Blog, DevOps Reading List, Archive. Current item is the leveling red.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: #14241c; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.65rem 0; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: #9d1c1c; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.25em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9d1c1c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Entry
components.description: A dated row. The whole row is the link.
components.css: .ds-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8.5rem 1fr; gap: 0.35rem 1rem; color: #14241c; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; padding: 0.4rem 0; } .ds-entry time { font-family: 'Big Shoulders Text', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: #3c5348; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-entry span { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #b7c9be; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-entry:hover span { text-decoration-color: #9d1c1c; } .ds-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9d1c1c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Double rule
components.description: The leveling mark under the wordmark and section headings.
components.css: .ds-level span { display: block; height: 1px; background: #9d1c1c; } .ds-level span + span { margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Archived label
components.description: Marks a post that remains published but is off the front page.
components.css: .ds-flag { color: #9d1c1c; font-family: 'Big Shoulders Text', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

narrative.overview: The site is a bound level book: a green page on a deeper green cover, with a double red leveling rule as the only ornament. The reading column stays quiet so a 2014 essay and a 2020 debugging note can sit in the same measure.
keyCharacteristics: The cover (ground) shows around a lighter sheet. Nothing floats on a shadow.
Big Shoulders Text carries the wordmark, years, and reading-order numerals. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries the essays.
One motion: the masthead rule draws in from the left. Section rules are the same mark, already there.
Dark mode is the same book under a lamp, not a second theme.
dos: Edit the home reading list in data/start-here.yaml.
Mark a post archived: true to remove it from the front page without taking down its URL.
Keep focus visible, and keep body text on the sheet at 68 characters.
donts: Put a card around every essay or list row.
Use the station face for paragraphs.
Add analytics, comment embeds, or a Google+ control back into the chrome.
Label the X profile or the share link as Twitter.
